import sys
import re

class TextDocumentAnalysis:
    WORD = re.compile(r'[^_()]+')

    @staticmethod
    def input(s: str) -> str:
        max_len = 0
        words = 0
        for m in TextDocumentAnalysis.WORD.finditer(s):
            length = len(m.group())
            end = m.end()
            if end < len(s):
                next_char = s[end]
                if next_char == '(':
                    if length > max_len:
                        max_len = length
                elif next_char == ')':
                    words += 1
                else:
                    last_open = s.rfind('(', 0, end)
                    last_close = s.rfind(')', 0, end)
                    if last_open > last_close:
                        words += 1
                    elif length > max_len:
                        max_len = length
            else:
                last_open = s.rfind('(', 0, end)
                last_close = s.rfind(')', 0, end)
                if last_open > last_close:
                    words += 1
                elif length > max_len:
                    max_len = length
        return f"{max_len} {words}"

def main():
    while True:
        line1 = sys.stdin.readline()
        if not line1:
            break
        line2 = sys.stdin.readline()
        if not line2:
            break
        result = TextDocumentAnalysis.input(line2.rstrip('\n'))
        print(result)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
